serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Sorry, but I refuse to follow orders of someone I don’t even know.
???: What?!
???: Are you kidding me?! You can’t just refuse now! Everything is planned out! 
You: Well, you can just tell me your name, right? 
???: Alright, ok?!
???: My name is…
???: Fuck you! Like hell I’m gonna tell you my name, stupid! I will make sure that you get banned you fucking fed!
You: Calm down, ok?
???: …
You: Hello?
He hung up. 
Well, that didn’t go as I planned…
Will I really get banned? There’s no way, right?
